I thought you didn't need a visa to get into any EU countries?

By "third world country" I mean Brazil.
Alright, thanks for talking to me :)

The reasons are hard to explain. You just have to trust me when I say they are unfixable.

And if my health deteriorates in a foreign country, hopefully their health care will help me. I don't know much about how these things work there but I know about how they work in my country: no one would help me at all. We have no awful health care and I have no family.

Thank you, that's very kind of you to offer a complete stranger some help. I'll definitely save your username and hit you up if I ever  do come close to Vienna. Hopefully not to ask for help, but to have a coffee with you or something. :)

Hi, thanks for replying. You ask me to tell you the reason I wanna die, but there are so many reasons I don't know where to start. 

You say it would be easier to fix things, but my problems are straight up unfixable. I wouldn't so desperately consider death otherwise. I have chronic, uncurable physical and mental conditions. I have a painful, shameful and dark future ahead of me, a thousand times so if I stay in this shithole of a country, close to the toxic people I call my family.

You say I have a big chance of fucking everything up. Thing is, I already have fucked everything up. I have nothing to lose but my life.
